extras: Documentation was substantially created using AI.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's editor sees the unwrapped form — one long line per paragraph — and handles visual wrapping natively.
problem: Markdown files stored in Obsidian often lack consistent hard line breaks, making them difficult to read in external tools like terminals or Git diffs.
summary: Hard Wrap transparently hard-wraps markdown files on disk at a configurable column width while displaying them as soft-wrapped paragraphs in the editor.
